name: residual_gate_add
description: Gated residual add for diffusion blocks: product = cast(update * gate, residual.dtype); out = cast(residual + product, residual.dtype). gate may have the same shape as residual/update or be a single row [1, hidden] broadcast over rows. Returns a newly allocated tensor with residual's shape and dtype; inputs are read only. The suites exercise bfloat16 tensors in both full and broadcast gate layouts.
